en.title: Reported speech
en.summary: Reported speech tells what someone said without the exact words.

paragraphs: Direct speech gives the exact words of a speaker, in quotation marks. Reported (or indirect) speech tells what was said in the reporter's own words, and it changes the tenses, pronouns and time expressions to fit the new point of view.

items: He asked me **where I lived**. (reported question)

paragraphs: When the reporting verb is in the past, the verb in the reported clause usually moves one step back in time.

blocks.html:
Direct speechReported speech
present simple: "I work."past simple: She said she worked.
present continuous: "I am working."past continuous: She said she was working.
present perfect: "I have worked."past perfect: She said she had worked.
simple past: "I worked."past perfect: She said she had worked.
will: "I will work."would: She said she would work.
can: "I can work."could: She said she could work.

TypeDirectReported
yes / no question"Are you ready?"He asked if / whether I was ready.
wh- question"Where do you live?"He asked where I lived.
command"Sit down."He told me to sit down.
negative command"Don't go."He told me not to go.

paragraphs: Reported questions use statement word order, with no do and no question mark: She asked where he lived (not: where did he live).

items: Wrong: **He said me that he was ill.** Right: **He told me that he was ill.**
Wrong: **She asked where did I live.** Right: **where I lived**
Wrong: **He told that he was ill.** Right: **He said that he was ill.**
If the statement is still true, the tense may stay: She said that the Earth goes round the Sun.

ro.title: Vorbirea indirectă
ro.summary: Vorbirea indirectă transmite cuvintele unei persoane prin propoziții legate cu „că”, „dacă” sau „să”.

paragraphs: Vorbirea indirectă redă mesajul altei persoane fără ghilimele. Nu repetăm cuvintele exact așa cum au fost spuse. Folosim cuvinte de legătură pentru a uni propozițiile. Persoana verbului se schimbă după sens.

items: Tata mi-a cerut **să citesc** o carte.

paragraphs: Pentru o afirmație adăugăm conjuncția „că”. Pentru o întrebare simplă folosim conjuncția „dacă”. Pentru un ordin sau un îndemn folosim conjuncția „să”. Pronumele și forma verbului se schimbă firesc.

blocks.html:
Vorbire directăCuvânt de legăturăVorbire indirectă
„Sunt obosit.”căSpune că este obosit.
„Vii cu noi?”dacăÎntreabă dacă vin cu ei.
„Unde locuiești?”undeMă întreabă unde locuiesc.
„Învață lecția!”săÎmi cere să învăț lecția.
